synopsis: Horizon Europe assesses proposals on Excellence, Impact, and Quality and Efficiency of the Implementation; the glossary summarizes these criteria as excellence, impact and quality of implementation [f9838, f16462]. Its application form includes a critical-risks table, reinforcing the corpus’s broader finding that funders emphasize importance, feasibility and rigor, team and resources, risk, and observable tests of success [f9839, f9473]. Chapter 12 recommends Horizon Europe Part B work packages and the critical-risks table as templates for the heavy off-road collision mitigation validation plan [f9977]. Part B page limits are call-specific, so the corpus supplies no universal page allowance [f9990].

relations.note: The glossary restates the three proposal-scoring criteria in shortened form.
Both identify the critical-risks table as part of Horizon Europe.
Horizon Europe's scoring criteria support the broader convergence of funder questions.
The required risks table supports the finding that funders emphasize risk.
Applies Horizon Europe's framework and risks table to the machine-validation plan.
The application’s risks table provides an existing template for validation planning.
Using Part B as an application template requires checking the call-specific page limit.
